spell.whimsical_spells.flower_field.guid: Covers the ground around you with wildflowers. Rarely, a sunflower blooms.
spell.whimsical_spells.repair_item.guide: Spends your base mana to repair the damaged item in your hand. Cast while crouching to repair your worn armor instead, with lower efficiency. Repeated use on the same piece repairs less. Level 1: 20% hand / 12% armor. Level 5: 50% hand / 35% armor.
spell.whimsical_spells.magic_trace.guide: Senses the magical power of nearby structures and leaves a particle trail pointing to the closest one: strongholds, villages, woodland mansions and more. Does not detect jungle temples, pyramids or ancient cities. Higher level, longer range.
spell.whimsical_spells.jubelade.guide: Turns flower petals into steel and fires them in a straight line. Damages everything they pass through and stops at the first block. Higher level, longer range and damage.
spell.whimsical_spells.medrozobalt.guide: Turns your attack into a whirlwind that pushes and damages enemies around you. Higher level, larger radius and stronger push.
Hides your magical presence: hostile mobs detect you from much less distance for a while. Higher level, longer duration and better stealth.
spell.whimsical_spells.reamstroha.guide: Gathers the surrounding water into a huge sphere above the target and lets it fall as a cascade, soaking them: damage, slowness, and it puts out fire. Stronger when it rains or there is water nearby. Cast while crouching to drop the cascade on yourself and your allies: it puts out fire and grants resistance.
spell.whimsical_spells.meehkeit.guide: Detects nearby trapped chests, even hidden ones, and marks them with blue flame columns for a few seconds. Higher level, larger radius.
ui.whimsical_spells.repair_no_item: You need a damaged item in your hand
ui.whimsical_spells.repair_no_armor: None of your armor pieces are damaged
ui.whimsical_spells.trace_found: You sense a trace of magical power...
ui.whimsical_spells.trace_none: You sense no trace of magical power nearby
ui.whimsical_spells.trace_here: The magical power is right here
ui.whimsical_spells.meehkeit_none: You sense no trapped chests nearby
ui.whimsical_spells.meehkeit_found: Trapped chests nearby: %s. The closest is %s blocks to the %s
spell.whimsical_spells.reelseiden.guide: A straight slash that cuts almost anything: it opens a slit through blocks up to the hardness of stone and kills any mob or player it reaches in one hit. It stops at harder blocks such as deepslate, ores or obsidian. Higher level, longer range.
ui.whimsical_spells.redirect_few: You need at least two hostile mobs nearby
ui.whimsical_spells.flight_on: Flight enabled (double-jump to take off again after landing)
ui.whimsical_spells.flight_creative: You can already fly in this game mode
item.whimsical_spells.ability_scroll_fli: Right-click to learn the passive ability Raywing (Flight).
item.whimsical_spells.ability_scroll_med: Right-click to learn the passive ability Meditation.
ui.whimsical_spells.ability_locked: You have not learned the ability %s yet
spell.whimsical_spells.dragon_slave.guid: The great fire spell: after a long chant, fires a red beam that damages and ignites everything it crosses and explodes at the end without breaking blocks. Higher level, longer range and more damage.
spell.whimsical_spells.ra_tilt.guide: A pillar of holy light falls from the sky on the target and damages those nearby. Deals double damage to undead and sets them on fire.
spell.whimsical_spells.shadow_snap.guide: Pins the shadow of the target you look at, leaving it unable to move or jump, though it can still attack what is next to it.
spell.whimsical_spells.sleeping.guide: Puts the creature you look at to sleep: it cannot move or attack. It wakes up if it takes damage.
spell.whimsical_spells.aqua_create.guide: Conjures temporary water where you look. Higher levels cover more area and last longer. It evaporates in the Nether.
spell.whimsical_spells.aqua_breathe.guid: Lets you and nearby allies breathe underwater.
spell.whimsical_spells.levitation.guide: Lifts the creature you look at or, if you look at none, yourself (with a soft landing when it ends).
spell.whimsical_spells.lighting.guide: Leaves a temporary sphere of light where you look. Higher levels last longer.
spell.whimsical_spells.fireproof_techniq: Fire resistance for you and nearby allies, and puts out any fire on you.
spell.whimsical_spells.warmth_spell.guid: Removes freezing and cold slowness from you and nearby allies. Higher level, larger radius.
spell.whimsical_spells.cold_spell.guide: A wave of cold around you that freezes and slows enemies and puts out their fire.
spell.whimsical_spells.disenchanting_wor: Removes negative effects from you or the ally you look at.
Breaks the positive effects of the target you look at: its protective spells and buffs.
spell.whimsical_spells.boost.guide: More speed and jump for you and nearby allies for a minute. Higher level, stronger effect.
spell.whimsical_spells.strengthening.gui: Strength for you and nearby allies. From level 2 it also grants damage resistance.
ui.whimsical_spells.spell_break_none: It has no positive effects to break
